title: Ace's Edible Blocks
description: Adds edible blocks to the game
body:
![Edible blocks logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98fde3c568170524e773e4d873c897d1852d361c.png)

Wanted to ever eat cobblestone? Well now you can, with this mod! I don't know why you would want to eat diamond blocks and obsidian (even glowstone!), but hey, what's gonna stop you if you have 2 of the block you want and 2 wheat seeds?

This mod adds:

Edible blocks (duh)

Bread blocks (whaaa)

Cursed advancements

...if you expected me to say "and more", you are mistaken (whaaa).

-------

Not all blocks are avaivable to make edible, but the recipe is easy!
